wiki.title: Rachelle Smit
wiki.extract: Rachelle Smit is an American politician serving as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives since 2023, representing the 43rd district. A member of the Republican Party, Smit has served as speaker pro tempore of the House since January 2025.
